**Parity Scoring:**
*   **Topbar:** 9/10 (Trial button color is lighter/pinkish in clone vs. dark blue).
*   **Subnav + Hero:** 8/10 (Subnav shows "Video" instead of "Image"; Hero subtitle includes "Gen-1.5 V1.2").
*   **Input Card Cluster:** 10/10 (Identical layout and icons).
*   **GENERATE Capsule:** 10/10 (Visual match).
*   **Controls Row:** 7/10 (Clone adds "Agentic Mode", "5 min", "Sign in to start", and changes model text).
*   **Overall First Impression:** 8/10.

**Remaining Differences:**
The sub-navigation tab has changed from **"Image"** to **"Video"**. The hero subtitle now displays **"Gen-1.5 V1.2"** alongside the original text. The bottom controls row is significantly different, featuring an **"Agentic Mode"** toggle, a **"5 min"** timer pill, a **"Sign in to start"** button, and updated labeling for the model version (**"Gen-2.5 Agent-Ready"**) and quality setting (**"High"** with a dropdown arrow). The **"Featured"** button under the Asset header has shifted slightly right.
